result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (verified via disposable detached clone in /tmp; /workspace/repo left clean at assigned baseline 5672ead). Scope: test coverage gaps, ineffective assertions, fake divergence, startup flake, port races, fixture cleanup. 5 findings, all mutation-confirmed: each single-line production change leaves the full suite at 262 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail. F1 MEDIUM src/cli.ts:205 - the real `swarmforge serve` command is never started by any test; a no-op serve returning 0 keeps the suite green, and every serve test stops at --check-config or substitutes tests/fixtures/compiled-serve.ts which bypasses src/cli.ts. Reachability independently confirmed by compiling the CLI and observing it reach runServe. F2 MEDIUM scripts/build.ts:181 + scripts/package.ts:461 - `bun run build` and `bun run package`, the exact commands release.yml:60,63 run, are never executed; only their exported functions are called with explicit args. F3 MEDIUM src/files.ts:57 - the artifact-listing symlink-kind filter is dead to the suite because tests/helpers.ts hardcodes kind:"file"; deleting it leaves the suite green. F4 LOW src/coordinator.ts:598 - the OpenCode turn-error branch is never reached, so operators get a generic failure message instead of the provider error name. F5 LOW src/settings/paths.ts:15 - the USERPROFILE home fallback is untested. Baseline suite is green. Port-race and 5s boot-budget concerns were probed and found sound (154-157ms boot, 0/200 rebind failures).
result.details:
Method: read repo instructions, cloned target to /tmp/opencode/sf48/target, confirmed rev-parse HEAD. Installed official Bun 1.4.2 to /tmp/opencode/bun142 (snapshot bun is 1.3.14, cannot read this lockfileVersion 2); bun install --frozen-lockfile into the /tmp clone only, no lockfile rewrite. Baseline `bun test` exit 0: 262 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail, 263 tests / 21 files, 66.2s. Targeted: serve+process-lock 23 pass; packaging 35 pass.

Each finding was confirmed by single-line mutation in a throwaway copy at /tmp/opencode/sf48/mutant, never in the source checkout. All five mutations left the full suite at 262 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail, exit 0.

F1 src/cli.ts:205 - inserting an early `return 0;` before `return runServe(settings.value)` keeps the suite green. All serve-touching tests return earlier: commands.test.ts:753,789 and packaging.test.ts:234,514 use --check-config which returns at cli.ts:199 before the dynamic import; serve.test.ts calls runServe/startServer directly; packaging.test.ts:349-525 substitutes tests/fixtures/compiled-serve.ts which imports runServe itself. Independently confirmed reachable: compiled the CLI with scripts/build.ts settings, ran `<binary> serve` with a local double config, observed it reach runServe and exit 1 with "Startup failed; no SwarmForge listener is running". Impact: a regression makes the documented production entry point (README.md:21) exit 0 with no listener and no supervision failure.

F2 scripts/build.ts:181-192, scripts/package.ts:461 - stubbing compileCli() and stubbing the bare packageCli() branch each leave tests/packaging.test.ts at 35 pass. packaging.test.ts:845-846 asserts only that package.json strings name the scripts. Default resolution (distDirectory, packageVersion, repositoryCommit) and repositoryCommit's own throw at build.ts:118-122 are unexercised. The release job then fails at if-no-files-found: error rather than in tests.

F3 src/files.ts:57 - deleting `e.kind !== "symlink" &&` leaves the suite green. src/providers/freestyle.ts:308-310 passes the SDK DirEntry through unchanged and node_modules/freestyle/dist/vms/types.d.ts:449-453 documents kind as file|directory|symlink. Probe with a realistic DirEntry[] confirmed the guard is the only thing keeping a symlink entry out of listings; the read path independently refuses it, so this is listing integrity / information disclosure, not a read escape. tests/helpers.ts:93-97 hardcodes kind:"file"; the only symlink test (api.test.ts:183-190) overrides stat, not listFiles.

F4 src/coordinator.ts:596-599 - collapsing the else to a single generic fail() leaves the suite green. No test constructs an AgentMessage with error set; FakeAgent.complete only sets result. Probe confirmed the branch is reachable and currently correct, so this is a latent gap, not a live bug.

F5 src/settings/paths.ts:15 - reducing the loop to ["HOME"] leaves settings+commands+inspect at 76 pass. No test mentions USERPROFILE. Low because the project advertises linux-x64-glibc only.

Checked and found sound: freePort/port helpers (200-iteration probe, 0 rebind failures, 0 duplicate ports despite the un-awaited void probe.stop); healthy() 5s budget vs 154/157/155ms measured boot.

Scoped note: packaging.test.ts:1139-1142 asserts no tmp.* remains in the global /tmp rather than its own mkdtemp root, so an unrelated process fails the suite. Confirmed reproducible both ways (stray /tmp entry -> exit 1; README trap removed -> exit 1 as intended). Fails loudly and caught its own mutation, so reported as a note rather than a numbered finding; fix is a per-test TMPDIR.

No real provider, model or infrastructure endpoint was contacted. No secrets in outputs; credential-shaped strings in probes are placeholders. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md (12128 bytes) and findings.json (10283 bytes). Logs: /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/w48-serve-probe.log.

tests.summary: Baseline suite green at the exact target; all five findings are mutation-confirmed coverage gaps where a one-line production change leaves the full suite passing. No pre-existing failures observed. tests.passed=true refers to the unmodified baseline, which is green; the mutated variants intentionally also pass and that is the finding.

warnings: Mutation testing is a coverage proxy, not proof of a production bug. Only F1's reachability was independently confirmed against a compiled binary; F2-F5 are latent gaps.
No real Freestyle, OpenCode or model endpoint was contacted, per the no-real-infrastructure constraint. Serve reachability used a local double and a loopback-unroutable provider URL.
Coverage was not measured numerically; findings come from reading the delta's new surfaces plus targeted mutation, not from a coverage report.

tests/packaging.test.ts:1139-1142 asserts on the global /tmp instead of its own mkdtemp root, so any unrelated process creating a tmp.* entry fails the suite. Reproduced both directions; reported as a scoped note, not a numbered finding.

result.followup_reason: Five actionable test-coverage findings, all reproduced by mutation against the exact target. Highest value first: (1) MEDIUM src/cli.ts:205 - add a test that actually starts the real `swarmforge serve` command and asserts it serves and exits non-zero on signal; every current serve test stops at --check-config or bypasses src/cli.ts via tests/fixtures/compiled-serve.ts, so a no-op serve exits 0 with a fully green suite. (2) MEDIUM scripts/build.ts:181 and scripts/package.ts:461 - add tests that execute `bun scripts/build.ts` and `bun scripts/package.ts` as programs, since release.yml:60,63 runs exactly these and only their exported functions are currently called. (3) MEDIUM src/files.ts:57 - add an artifacts-listing test with a kind:"symlink" DirEntry; tests/helpers.ts hardcodes kind:"file" so the filter is dead to the suite. (4) LOW src/coordinator.ts:598 - add a lifecycle test driving an assistant reply with error set and result undefined. (5) LOW src/settings/paths.ts:15 - add a USERPROFILE fallback unit test. Also worth fixing: scope the /tmp leftover assertion in tests/packaging.test.ts:1139 to a per-test TMPDIR.
